anomalies.obs: On the Thermocouples sheet, U2 has a 1 µF decoupling cap (C3) and U4 has a 1 µF decoupling cap (C6) at their VCC pins, but U3 (MAX31855KASA) has no decoupling capacitor. In the position where U3's 1 µF VCC-to-GND cap should sit, the drawing shows R13 = 500 Ω connected from +3V3 to GND. There is also no C4 anywhere on the sheet, although the spec lists C4 as U4's cap and C6 as U3's cap.
anomalies.expected: The specification requires a 1 µF decoupling capacitor on every thermocouple channel's VCC pin: 'a 1 µF decoupling cap per channel (C3 for U2, C6 for U3, C4 for U4 ...)'. A 500 Ω resistor cannot decouple VCC; tied from +3V3 to GND it is a continuous ~6.6 mA load that provides no local charge reservoir.

evidence.quote: thermocouples.kicad_sch: U2 -> C3 1uF (+3V3/GND); U4 -> C6 1uF (+3V3/GND); U3 -> R13 500 (+3V3/GND), no capacitor at U3 VCC
Power: V_CC (pin 4) -> +3V3 ... with a 1 µF decoupling cap per channel (C3 for U2, C6 for U3, C4 for U4 ...)

anomalies.impact: U3's VCC is left undecoupled, so the U3 MAX31855 channel is susceptible to supply noise and SPI read faults (which the firmware turns into a ThermocoupleFault and trips a run), while R13 wastes power on the 3.3 V rail. The other two channels are unaffected.

parsed.summary: The power, heater-switch, USB, fan and SPI wiring all match the specification, but on the Thermocouples sheet U3 is missing its required 1 µF VCC decoupling capacitor; a 500 Ω resistor (R13) has been placed in that position instead, which is a wrong-component/missing-capacitor deviation that leaves one thermocouple channel undecoupled.
